about_the_game:
Waffle Spin Ball is a wild, fast-paced pinball-style arcade game with a delicious twist! Battle through 5 worlds and 25 uniquely designed levels packed with chaos, challenge, and charm as you bounce, spin, and smash your way to victory.

Choose from 10 distinct characters, each bringing their own flavor to the flipper-fueled frenzy. Whether you're mastering the art of timing or just trying to keep your ball alive, you'll find plenty to keep you coming back.

Collect game-changing power-ups and avoid the dreaded power-downs as the action ramps up with each level. Want an extra edge? Uncover hidden cheats and unlock secret abilities to turn the tables!

Compete for glory with your local high score or aim for the global spotlight with a networked high score leaderboard that ranks the top 5 players worldwide.
